description: Asymmetrical voltage processor: it cuts the signal at a threshold voltage and delays, shapes, folds and slews the part above it separately from the part below it

params.text: Sets the voltage that divides the signal into its two parts, -10V to 10V
Crossfades the main output between the untouched input and the processed signal
Attenuates and inverts the threshold CV
Removes any DC offset from the main output
Attenuates and inverts the CV for the control it belongs to, and passes none of it at the centre
Delays the part of the signal below the threshold, from 1ms up to 10 seconds, with no delay at all at the bottom of its travel
Delays the part of the signal above the threshold, from 1ms up to 10 seconds, with no delay at all at the bottom of its travel
Bends the part of the signal below the threshold, flattening it towards 0V turned one way from the centre and pushing it out towards the rails turned the other; at the centre it is unchanged
Bends the part of the signal above the threshold, flattening it towards 0V turned one way from the centre and pushing it out towards the rails turned the other; at the centre it is unchanged
Sets the level at which the part of the signal below the threshold folds back on itself, folding more the further down its travel it goes and not at all at the top
Sets the level at which the part of the signal above the threshold folds back on itself, folding more the further down its travel it goes and not at all at the top
Limits how fast the part of the signal below the threshold can change, from 100000V per second at the bottom of its travel to 0.1V per second at the top
Limits how fast the part of the signal above the threshold can change, from 100000V per second at the bottom of its travel to 0.1V per second at the top

inputs.text: Shifts the threshold through its attenuverter, one volt of threshold per volt at full
The signal to be cut at the threshold and processed; one channel only
Moves the wet and dry balance of the main output, a tenth of the range per volt
Adds to the delay on the part of the signal below the threshold, a tenth of the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the delay on the part of the signal above the threshold, a tenth of the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the bend on the part of the signal below the threshold, half the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the bend on the part of the signal above the threshold, half the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the fold level for the part of the signal below the threshold, a tenth of the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the fold level for the part of the signal above the threshold, a tenth of the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the slew limit on the part of the signal below the threshold, a tenth of the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter
Adds to the slew limit on the part of the signal above the threshold, a tenth of the knob's range per volt at full attenuverter

outputs.text: The processed part of the signal that falls below the threshold, holding the threshold voltage itself whenever the signal is above it
Both processed parts put back together, crossfaded with the dry input by the Wet/Dry knob and filtered for DC when the DC switch is on
The processed part of the signal that rises above the threshold, holding the threshold voltage itself whenever the signal is below it

notes: The module is mono: only the first channel of a cable patched into In is read, and each output carries a single channel.
